title: India Invites Designs for BWF World Championships 2026 Mascot
indian_angle: India is hosting the BWF World Championships 2026, and this competition involves Indian public participation in its promotion.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has launched a mascot design competition for the upcoming BWF World Championships 2026, which India will host.

title: Junior Shuttlers Train in Guwahati for World Championships
indian_angle: This camp prepares India's top junior shuttlers for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships in Cairo, Egypt.
summary: A national coaching camp is currently underway at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, preparing Indian junior players for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Opens Applications for Players of Outstanding Merit
indian_angle: This notification allows Indian players who have demonstrated exceptional talent to apply for special recognition or support from BAI.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has invited applications from players demonstrating outstanding merit, likely for special programs or recognition.

title: Advanced Coaches Course Held in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: This course aims to enhance the skills of Indian badminton coaches, which is vital for developing future national and international players.
summary: BAI conducted an advanced Level-1 Coaches Course across two national centers, Guwahati and Raipur, from September 14th to 23rd, 2026.

title: India's U17 & U15 Teams Camp for Asia Junior Championships
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for preparing young Indian talent for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships, fostering future champions.
summary: The Indian junior team for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 underwent a coaching camp at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System Adopted for Junior Domestic Events
indian_angle: This significant rule change in domestic junior tournaments will impact how young Indian players compete and train, aligning with international trends.
summary: BAI has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for U-13, U-15, and U-17 domestic ranking tournaments and national championships.
